content:
The highly anticipated fourth season of Ted Lasso is now streaming on Apple TV+ and has been a massive hit, but three more high-profile new releases are arriving soon.

#1: 'Dark Matter'

Apple TV+ has plenty of fantastic sci-fi shows for you to watch. While Severance and Pluribus are already well-known titles, there's one beloved series you may have missed: Dark Matter.

The show is adapted from the best-selling novel by Blake Crouch and stars Joel Edgerton and Jennifer Connelly.

Dark Matter Season 2 will premiere its first two episodes on Friday, August 28, with new episodes released weekly until the season finale on October 30.

Here's the synopsis from Apple:

#2: 'Mayday'

Apple TV+ has a lineup of new films coming this autumn, most of which will premiere on the streaming platform first rather than in theaters.

Kicking things off is Mayday, an action comedy starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh — a humorous spin on a classic spy thriller.

Mayday will be available exclusively on Apple TV+ starting Friday, September 4.

Here's the plot synopsis and trailer from Apple:

#3: 'Slow Horses'

One of Apple's highest-rated shows, Slow Horses, is set to return.

In the streaming era, viewers often have to wait several years for new seasons of their favorite shows. But Slow Horses comes back every year, continuing the thrilling spy adventures of Gary Oldman as Jackson Lamb and his team.

Slow Horses Season 6 will premiere its first two episodes on Wednesday, September 16, with new episodes released weekly until the season finale on October 21.

Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, or you can subscribe through the Apple One bundle for a discounted price.
